architectureDecision.reason: Architecture is not required because the approved scope is a single static Astro page with no additional routes, shared application state, persistence, backend or external API integration, authentication, migration, security/privacy-sensitive data flow, or cross-service reliability/observability concerns. The only client-side state is the bounded Work carousel, already specified as isolated progressive enhancement, so a separate architecture artifact or Lite profile upgrade would add process without reducing material implementation risk.
